summary.text: Tony Strickland is a Republican member of the California State Senate from District 36 who took office on March 11, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the California State Senate from 2008 to 2012 and the State Assembly from 1998 to 2004.

paragraphs.text: Tony Strickland earned a B.A. in political science from Whittier College, and his professional experience includes working as vice president of Green Wave Energy Solutions, LLC.
Strickland served in California State Assembly District 37 from 1998 to 2004 and was elected to California State Senate District 19 in 2008, serving until 2012.
He ran for the U.S. House in California's 25th District in 2014, advanced from the blanket primary and lost the general election to Steve Knight.
He won the special primary for State Senate District 36 outright on February 25, 2025, with 51.3 percent of the vote, succeeding Janet Nguyen.
In the June 2, 2026 primary Strickland received 53.4 percent and advanced to the general election against Democrat Chris Duncan.

For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Senate Transportation Committee and the Labor, Public Employment and Retirement Committee, and a member of the Banking and Financial Institutions; Energy, Utilities and Communications; and Business, Professions and Economic Development committees.
